layout.name: manifest
layout.canonicalization: UTF-8, no BOM, no insignificant whitespace, fixed key order as listed in manifest_fields, decimal integers without leading zeroes, lowercase JSON booleans

manifest_invariants.seed: resolved uint64 encoded as a decimal JSON string
manifest_invariants.payload_sha256_coverage: all record bytes, excluding the 4096-byte header
manifest_invariants.split: train, validation, or test according to the preregistered contiguous chunk ranges
manifest_invariants.producer_attestation: bound externally by the OpenBench protocol-41 publication receipt and intentionally excluded from canonical chunk bytes
manifest_invariants.worker_resources: bound externally by the OpenBench receipt and intentionally excluded from canonical chunk bytes
manifest_invariants.retry: one logical chunk must reproduce identical uncompressed bytes across workers
